text:
Sam T: Hey everyone, first week Q - I can open Console (staging) but I need a service account token to run an automated smoke for the feature-flag task. Who should I ask for a service-token:staging?
Infra Team: Hi Sam 2 welcome! Service tokens are a separate request. Please file one ticket and request `service-token:staging` and `ff-operator` if the token will toggle flags. Include the exact TTL and the purpose.
Sam T: Filed REQ-99987 (okta: sam.t@redwood.dev). I set TTL=24h and noted it's for CI smoke runs on onboarding_demo_flag.
DevEx Bot: Tip: For automation use the service token instead of a user token. Docs: https://go/redwood-devex/service-tokens. Also include the repo and CI job name so infra can scope the token to that usage.
Aisha R: Sam - I approve the purpose (onboarding smoke). One extra ask from Security: add a short rotation plan in the ticket and confirm the token storage location (secrets manager).
Sam T: Added rotation plan and noted we'll store the token in the team vault (secret path: teams/sam/onboard/ci).
Security Squad: We'll approve once infra confirms the token scope and vault path. Reminder: service tokens for staging can be scoped to API routes and flagged actions. No broad prod scopes.
Infra Team: Granting `service-token:staging` scoped to `flags:read,flags:toggle` and `api:health` for REQ-99987, TTL 24h. Token will be uploaded to your requested vault path by ops and the ticket will include the token reference.
Sam T: Received the secret ref and validated the CI job picks it up. Ran a smoke locally with the token: ```bash
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=$(vault read -field=value teams/sam/onboard/ci)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood/health | jq .status
``` Returned: "ok".
DevEx Bot: Nice. Quick reminder: if your CI toggles flags, add a safety guard like limiting rollouts to <5% and an automatic revert if error rate spikes. See FF playbook: https://go/redwood-devex/ff-playbook.
Sam T: Good call. I added a canary step in the CI job and a revert stage. Also noted we won't use this token in shared scripts.
Aisha R: Looks good. Infra, please confirm the audit stream shows the service token actions so we can tie them back to the job.
Infra Team: Confirmed 2 audit entries for `service-token:staging` actions will include the token id and the ticket reference. We logged the grant in the entitlement audit.
Security Squad: Approved. Two follow-ups: 1) schedule token rotation if you need longer than 24h, 2) avoid granting prod scopes to service tokens without extra review.
Sam T: Will request renewal if needed. Thanks everyone for the quick help! :party_parrot:
Onboard Bot: If you want a walkthrough of safe FF toggles in CI, book a short session with #devex. Also check the CI snippets in https://go/redwood-devex/ci-ff-snippets.
